name: SiteBridge Tracking Connector for ClickGrow
author: clickgrow

sections.description:
SiteBridge Tracking Connector for ClickGrow links your WordPress site to your ClickGrow account for website tracking.

Website tracking — Loads your ClickGrow tracking script automatically after you connect.

Blog publishing is not handled by this plugin. If you use ClickGrow to publish posts, create a WordPress Application Password yourself under Users → Profile and add it in ClickGrow. This plugin does not create users, log anyone in, or send Application Passwords off the site.

This plugin is a connector for the ClickGrow service (https://www.clickgrow.ai/), operated by Clickgrow Ai LLC. A ClickGrow account is required. See ClickGrow’s Terms of Use and Privacy Policy.

How to connect

  1. Install and activate SiteBridge Tracking Connector for ClickGrow.
  2. Open SiteBridge in the WordPress admin.
  3. Click Connect to ClickGrow and finish in your ClickGrow account.
  4. Or open a Finish link from ClickGrow — the plugin connects automatically.

No need to paste tokens on the happy path. An advanced “Enter connection code” option is available for recovery only.

Privacy

Connecting is explicit consent to use the ClickGrow service. Until you connect, the plugin does not load tracking scripts or call ClickGrow APIs.

When you connect, your WordPress server may send to ClickGrow:

  • Your site URL
  • A short-lived setup token from the Connect / Finish flow

This plugin does not create WordPress users, log users in, create Application Passwords, or send site credentials. After tracking is connected, the plugin loads the ClickGrow tracking script on the public site (HTTPS URLs on ClickGrow or Supabase hosts only). Connection API calls run from your WordPress server (not the visitor browser).

Uninstalling removes stored connection options and stops the tracking script. Disconnect buttons let you turn off tracking independently.

Privacy Policy: https://www.clickgrow.ai/privacy-policy
Terms of Use: https://www.clickgrow.ai/terms-of-use
sections.installation:
1. Upload the sitebridge-tracking-for-clickgrow folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install the zip via Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin.
  2. Activate SiteBridge Tracking Connector for ClickGrow through the Plugins menu.
  3. Go to SiteBridge in the admin menu and click Connect to ClickGrow.
sections.faq:
Do I need to paste a code?

No. Use Connect to ClickGrow, or open the Finish link from ClickGrow. Paste is only for recovery.

Free WordPress.com plans

Free WordPress.com sites cannot install plugins. Use ClickGrow’s paste or Approve options, or upgrade WordPress.com.

Can I disconnect tracking without disconnecting blogging?

Yes. Disconnect tracking clears tracking on this WordPress site and in ClickGrow. Blog publishing in ClickGrow is unchanged.

Blog publishing shows On — how do I disconnect it?

If Blog publishing is mirrored from ClickGrow (connected via Application Password in ClickGrow), use Clear local status to hide the On badge here only. To disconnect blogging credentials, manage them in ClickGrow → Blog CMS. This plugin never removes ClickGrow blogging credentials.

Does this plugin let ClickGrow administer my site?

No. It does not install plugins or themes, create users, or send Application Passwords. After an administrator clicks Connect, it only loads the tracking script.

What data does the plugin send?

See the Privacy section above. Nothing is sent until an administrator clicks Connect (or completes a Finish link) on the SiteBridge admin page.
sections.changelog:
1.1.1

  • Finish deep links require a nonce-verified Confirm step before stashing or finalizing a pairing token (CSRF hardening).

1.1.0

  • Rename display name and slug to SiteBridge Tracking Connector for ClickGrow / sitebridge-tracking-for-clickgrow for wordpress.org trademark compliance.

1.0.9

  • Sync Blog publishing On/Off from ClickGrow on admin load; heal stale mirrored status after finalize.
  • Disconnect tracking clears local options and ClickGrow tracking; mirrored blogging offers Clear local status only.
  • Clearer errors for site URL mismatch, already connected on another site, and blogging-via-ClickGrow.
  • Enable tracking only when the script URL is on an allowlisted host.

1.0.8

  • When website tracking connects, show Blog publishing as On if that site was already connected in ClickGrow (manual Application Password).

1.0.7

  • Rename display name and slug to Clickgrow AI Connector / clickgrow-ai-connector for wordpress.org trademark compliance.

1.0.6

  • Directory review: enqueue auto-connect JS; do not create or send Application Passwords; tracking-only remote calls.

1.0.5

  • Directory readiness: clearer privacy/terms disclosure; hide environment overrides unless explicitly enabled; allow only trusted hosts for the tracking script URL.

1.0.4

  • Match admin accent/wordmark blue to ClickGrow logo (#0080fb).

1.0.3

  • Fix deep-link auto-finalize when Continue shadowed form.submit; keep ClickGrow menu icon.

1.0.2

  • Use the ClickGrow lightning-bolt brand mark as the admin sidebar menu icon.

1.0.1

  • Redesigned admin page: branded header, connecting spinner, purpose cards, safer disconnect confirm, nested custom environment URLs.

1.0.0

  • Initial release: Connect to ClickGrow, deep-link auto-finalize, tracking enqueue, blogging Application Password, per-capability disconnect.
